structuredEvidence.definition: Ammihud , the name of three Israelites

evidence: Lexicon or morphology identifies this as a proper name
Occurrence trail contains male relationship language

firstOccurrence.englishText: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

majorEvents.label: Offering
majorEvents.evidenceText: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.

timeline.evidenceText: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
“On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim,
and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.
The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.
Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”
But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur, king of Geshur. David mourned for his son every day.
Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.

definitions.short: Ammihud , the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H5989. Ammihud עַמִּיהוּד proper name, masculine ( my kinsman is majesty ); — ᵐ5 ( Σ ) εμιουδ , Αμιουδ , etc.: 1 a Geshurite 2Sam 13:37 Qr (> Kt עַמִּיחוּר , compare Dr and others, Gray Prop. N. 43 ). 2 an Ephraimite Num 1:10 ; 2:18 ; 7:48 , 53 ; 10:22 (all P), 1Chr 7:26 . 3 a Simeonite Num 34:20 . 4 a Naphtalite Num 34:28 . 5 a Judahite 1Chr 9:4 .
